\# Adds a processing status to submitted stablecoin payments

\## What’s new

\[PaymentIntents\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_intents.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) confirmed with the \`crypto\` payment method for \[stablecoin payments\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/stablecoin-payments.md) now have a \[status\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_intents/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover#payment\_intent\_object-status) of \`processing\` when a user submits a transaction to the blockchain for processing. Users only redirect back to your integration when a payment is finalized.

\## Impact

Previously, the PaymentIntent denoted success or failure by transitioning from \`requires\_action\` to either \`succeeded\` or \`requires\_payment\_method\`.

With this change, when using the \`crypto\` payment method:

\- If you \[retrieve\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_intents/retrieve.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) the PaymentIntent while customers are waiting for the transaction to confirm, the \`status\` field now shows a value of \`processing\`.
\- If you attempt to \[cancel\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_intents/cancel.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) a confirmed PaymentIntent with the \`processing\` status, the request fails with error \`payment\_intent\_invalid\_cancellation\_state\`.

You can optionally set up your webhook endpoint to listen for the \`payment\_intent.processing\` event to be notified when the PaymentIntent transitions to the \`processing\` status.

The customer isn’t redirected while the PaymentIntent has the \`processing\` status, so your checkout experience shouldn’t require any changes.

\## Upgrade

\#### REST API

1\. \[View your current API version\](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2\. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2025-09-30.clover\`
3\. Upgrade the API version used for \[webhook endpoints\](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4\. \[Test your integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5\. If you use Connect, \[test your Connect integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about \[Stripe API upgrades\](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
